properties.title: Marine Weather Statement issued August 30 at 9:16AM CDT by NWS Mobile AL
properties.description:
At 913 AM CDT...Thunderstorms mostly located along a line from near
Perdido Pass to 18 nm west of Oriskany Reef were moving northwest at
20 knots. These storms and others in the statement area will be
capable of producing waterspouts and wind gusts up to 30 knots.

Locations impacted include...
Orange Beach, Central Dauphin Island, Sand Island Lighthouse, Fort
Gaines, Gulf Shores Beach, Dauphin Island Bridge, Western Dauphin
Island, Fort Morgan, Bon Secour Bay, and Farewell Buoy.

Boaters should consider seeking safe harbor until these storms have
passed.

Weather conditions support the development of waterspouts.
Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally hazardous
waves and seas. If a waterspout is sighted...seek safe harbor
immediately.
properties.area: South Mobile Bay; Mississippi Sound; Perdido Bay Area; Coastal waters from Pensacola FL to Pascagoula MS out 20 NM; Waters from Pensacola FL to Pascagoula MS from 20 to 60 NM

properties.title: Flood Warning issued August 30 at 9:10AM CDT until August 31 at 1:00PM CDT by NWS Indianapolis IN
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Indiana...
Illinois...

Wabash River at Riverton

.Minor flooding continues on the Wabash River at Riverton. The river
has crested. Flooding is expected come to an end on the Wabash later
tonight.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring.

* WHERE...Wabash River at Riverton.

* WHEN...Until late Sunday night.

* IMPACTS...At 16.0 feet, Some agricultural lands underwater.  A few
rural roads in Crawford County, Illinois close as water backs up
Minnow Slough.  High water affects campground at Leaverton Park in
Palestine.  A few private roads near the Gill Township levee in
Sullivan County may flood.  Water level is at the top of most
makeshift levees.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:00 AM CDT /9:00 AM EDT/ Sunday the stage was 16.6 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 10.5 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage just
after midnight tonight and continue falling to 4.7 feet
Wednesday, September 09.
- Flood stage is 15.0 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov/ind.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 915 PM CDT /1015 PM
EDT/.
properties.area: Crawford, IL; Lawrence, IL; Knox, IN; Sullivan, IN

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued August 30 at 10:02AM EDT until August 30 at 1:00PM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Chatham County in southeastern Georgia...
Jasper County in southeastern South Carolina...

* WHEN...Until 100 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1001 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 1.5 inches of rain
have fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Tybee Island, Wilmington Island, Fort Pulaski National Monument,
Midtown Savannah, Hutchinson Island, Downtown Savannah,
Thunderbolt, Whitemarsh Island, Isle Of Hope and Sandfly.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.title: Marine Weather Statement issued August 30 at 9:53AM AST by NWS San Juan PR
properties.description:
The areas affected include...
Anegada Passage east of Virgin Gorda and Saint Croix south to 17N...
Caribbean waters of Puerto Rico from 10 NM to 17N, including the
coastal waters of Saint Croix...

* At 953 AM AST, Doppler radar indicated a strong thunderstorms,
capable of producing winds to around 40 knots and frequent
lightning. These thunderstorms were mainly over the offshore
Caribbean waters, moving southwest at 15 knots. with additional
thunderstorms approaching the Anegada Passage.

Locations impacted include...
Mainly open waters of Anegada Passage east of Virgin Gorda and
Saint Croix south to 17N and Caribbean waters of Puerto Rico from
10 NM to 17N, including the coastal waters of Saint Croix.
properties.instruction:
Mariners can expect gusty winds to around 30 knots, locally higher
waves, lightning strikes, and heavy downpours. Boaters should seek
safe harbor immediately until these storms pass.

Intense lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.

Report severe weather to the Coast Guard or nearest law enforcement
agency. They will relay your report to the National Weather Service
office.
properties.area: Anegada Passage east of Virgin Gorda and Saint Croix south to 17N; Caribbean Waters of Puerto Rico from 10 NM to 17N, including the Coastal Waters of Saint Croix

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued August 29 at 9:38PM MST until August 30 at 9:30AM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
* WHAT...Small stream flooding caused by excessive rainfall is
expected.

* WHERE...Central Pima County in southeastern Arizona...

* WHEN...Until 930 AM MST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Rises in small streams and normally dry washes. Overflowing poor
drainage areas. Some low-water crossings may become impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 934 PM MST, gauge reports indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms fell in the middle and upper reaches of the Vamori
Wash this evening. This will cause small stream flooding. Rises
in the Vamori Wash could be sudden, but the flood wave will
slowly travel downstream.
- This includes the following streams and drainages...
San Simon Wash, Hali Murk Wash, Chukut Kuk Wash, San Luis Wash
and Vamori Wash.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Santa Cruz and Kupk.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Remain alert for flooding even in locations not receiving rain.
Washes, streams, and rivers can become raging killer currents in a
matter of minutes, even from distant rainfall.
